description: Detects node configuration drift: BIOS versions, boot order, firmware, fan/thermal health, power draw, UFM fabric alarms and switch firmware. All nodes should match the gold standard — any deviation is highlighted in red.

options.content: ### On-Demand BMC Refresh The exporter on the BCM head polls every 10 minutes. To force an immediate re-poll for the selected node, click below — full firmware walk takes ~3 min. 🔄 Refresh BMC ${node:raw} *Select a specific node from the dropdown above. "All" will not work — pick one BMC IP.*

targets.expr: count(count by (serial) (redfish_boot_order_entry{cluster=~"$cluster",entry="Pxe", bmc=~"$node"} or redfish_boot_order_entry{cluster=~"$cluster",entry="Hdd", bmc=~"$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: [NO-EXPORTER-METRIC] Any node showing a different BIOS version from the majority is highlighted red. Consistent BIOS across the cluster is required for stable GPU/NVLink behaviour.
panels.title: BIOS Version per Node — All nodes should match

panels.description: [NO-EXPORTER-METRIC] Nodes booting from wrong device (e.g. local disk instead of PXE, or wrong NIC) will show a different position-0 entry. Mismatched boot order causes erratic provisioning and GPU node instability.
panels.title: Boot Order per Node — Position 0 is first boot device
🔧  Firmware Inventory — NIC, GPU, Drives, BMC

panels.description: [NO-EXPORTER-METRIC] All nodes should run identical firmware on NVLink switches, BlueField NICs, NVMe drives, and BMC. Firmware drift is the #1 cause of erratic cluster behaviour.
panels.title: Firmware Versions per Component — Mismatches across nodes indicate drift
🌡️  Thermal & Power — Fan Speeds, Temperatures, Power Draw

panels.description: Switch firmware drift = NVLink/IB instability. All switches should run the same fw version.
panels.title: Switch Inventory & Firmware
IB Port Active Count over Time

panels.description: Cluster Minder checks each node's boot order, firmware compliance, and health. Any non-compliant node should be investigated before workloads are scheduled on it.
